source_rows.result: Primitive orbit of size≥3 has interval active indices. Degree-two noninterval images are explicitly isolated; all such cases satisfy the main rank bound for n≥12. Therefore the source interval reduction is proved in the contradiction range r>(n−1)/2.
source_rows.unproved: The unrestricted literal interval assertion in the degree-two case is neither proved nor disproved.

new_reusable_argument: Ranks of two commuting intransitive string C-factors containing odd permutations, with transitive product of degree b≥10: sum≤floor((b−1)/2). Faithful smaller-orbit actions are justified, not presumed.
other_branches_not_claimed: Full small Table2 classification and Tables3–6
Remaining support induction and the complete L044 theorem
